reason: Hybrid of fundamentals, momentum, sentiment and instinct with no chart use or concrete quantifiable rules that can be coded.

universe.description: US stocks and options on companies understood by guest

setup.rule: Look for transitory negative events causing overreaction
setup.quote: First things are things I deem transitory events. ... the Ebola scare. When the Ebola scare came out, airlines got clobbered. ... I went in and I bought American Airlines

setup.rule: Negative sentiment and momentum on understandable companies
setup.quote: I love negative sentiment on a stock. ... sentiment momentum

entry.rule: Buy after big initial move down if fundamentals do not support zero
entry.quote: the stock was getting crushed. The debt load was enormous. ... I just didn't see how this thing was getting to zero ... I went in and I bought

stop.rule: Pre-define exit parameters before entry based on conviction
stop.quote: I always have my parameters set up before I enter it

exits.rule: Take profits at pre-set targets, possibly partial and free-roll remainder
exits.quote: if these options get to $2, I'm out. ... I'll take off the majority of a position, say 80% and I'll hold 20%

sizing.rule: Scale size with conviction and timeline; stocks for uncertain timeline, options for short-term
sizing.quote: the timing the level of intensity that I enter the trade is based on my own conviction ... Length of time and risk of capital

ambiguities.issue: No numeric thresholds or lookbacks given for any rule
